ordering_policy.primary: book quality and lasting learning value
ordering_policy.secondary: source text cleanliness and suitability for paragraph-level chunks

excluded.source_path: sources/popular-science/brian-greene/en/Light Falls - Space Time and an Obsession of Einstein - Brian Greene.zip
excluded.reason: ZIP/audio-style source, not a clean book text source for the trilingual writer.

generation_contract.translation_quality: Accurate, complete, modern, understandable, elegant Japanese and Chinese. Preserve scientific claims, analogies, distinctions, names, dates, and terminology.
generation_contract.grammar_analysis: Required. Use normalized grammar roles so color and black-white outputs can be compiled from the same JSON.
generation_contract.source_quality: Convert each PDF/EPUB into cleaned reference Markdown before chunking. Repair embedded-text hyphenation and I/pipe OCR artifacts; remove page chrome, boilerplate, duplicated headers, and accidental line wraps.
generation_contract.final_outputs: After generation, compile maximum-language large-font color and black-white PDFs with cover and TOC.
